native_path: In the already loaded AnatomyExplorer app.ui.model_view.ModelView, after its first-frame reset: apply_view(model_view, view_id, path_to_views_json, anchors=construction_manifest["anchors"]). All 24 additions are required by default; explicit require_refined_additions=False permits baseline-only state inspection with missing-addition diagnostics. Shared normal-selector/action/menu integration remains outside this specialist source phase.
camera_note: Native procedural positions are authored world coordinates, with no normalization. Regional cameras use loaded item bounding metadata. Local cameras accept saved common-settle-warped named 3-vector anchors; absent anchors fall back to explicitly unverified source seeds. Section anchors are authored-coordinate scalars quantized to the native 0–1000 slider, and requested/actual coordinates and quantization error are returned. No camera operation moves geometry.
native_acceptance: Every recipe transitions from each other recipe and resets previous ghosting, isolation, cut, sections, opacity and separation consistently.
Test opacity 100%, 50%, 8%; no material colors,vertex colors,normals,physical scale or coordinates change.
SagittalX/coronalZ/transverseY sections reveal finished meaningful boundaries, including galea underside, matrix/papilla and gland junction.
At separation 12%, all exposed epidermal faces explain cell populations; restore 0% and confirm neighbor contact.
Hide spinosum and sheaths in turn; local host islands/cuffs preserve melanocyte/sensory targets without false claims about absent tissue.
No view, render or native acceptance was executed in this source-only phase.

All 24 added selectors must be present in refined output; missing additions are allowed only during explicit baseline-only state inspection. Unknown additions remain visible and require a reviewed exact mapping.
Unchanged camera seeds and fitted/warped anchors are distinct evidence. Runtime checks report slider quantization but cannot establish anatomical plane alignment.
Compare overview, all three axis cutaways, both sheath-hide stages, hidden spinosum and galea underside. Native Practice must suppress selected/section/hover names for recognition without labels.
